exposure: sonographically estimated fetal weight using Hadlock formula
outcome: concordance between estimated and actual birth weight
absolute difference between estimated and actual birth weight
percentage error of fetal weight estimation
cohort: 200 females in their last trimester of pregnancy at term.
finding: The Hadlock formula showed 100% concordance and an absolute difference of 29+/-28.03 grams between estimated fetal weight and actual birth weight in a Pakistani population.
